evidence_brief.sdk_tag: unknown; existing Task 031 repository identity is used
documented_facts: The model has one 416x416 NCHW input and two [1,18,H,W] output heads.
The vendor configuration uses zero means, approximately 1/255 channel scales, confidence 0.35 and NMS IoU 0.45.
The vendor face decoder uses stride 16/32 anchors and sigmoid YOLO decoding followed by NMS.
The vendor camera script exports ArmNN and OpenCV runtime library paths.
source_code_facts: executor.cpp creates an ONNX parser, calls ArmNN Optimize with backend preferences, then LoadNetwork and CMA-backed buffers.
preprocess.cpp converts camera BGR/BGRA data to quantized planar RGB and applies model quantization parameters.
postprocess.cpp supports QAsymmU8/QSymmS8 outputs and performs sigmoid, anchor decode and NMS.
The project runner uses the same graph contract and forces a single Alnpu backend preference.
conflicts: The vendor camera executable defaults to a preference list that includes CPU backends; this task's project runner intentionally passes only Alnpu and rejects fallback.
unresolved_blockers: The custom YOLOv5n graph remains under Task 028/029/032 WAITING_FOR_VENDOR_INPUT and is not part of this closed loop.
evidence_brief.proposed_action: Use edgeai_armnn_face_image for a bounded image-control deployment and keep the vendor camera script as source evidence only.

project_flow: BGR -> RGB, HWC -> NCHW, divide by 255
dequantized output heads -> sigmoid/anchor decode -> confidence filter -> NMS
JSON detections and OpenCV annotated image
